note: Credit budget and goals for SocialCrawl. Estimates are computed from content/socialcrawl.json (typical = base cost, worst = x-credit-cost-max); spend comes from the ledger that scripts/socialcrawl.py writes. Edit this file to change the budget or add a goal; every call must name one of these goal ids.

budget.rule: Stop and review before total spend passes 80% of the budget; a goal may not exceed its own cap without --over-cap.

goals.title: One-request depth test on @demo.trail
goals.why: How many posts a single SocialCrawl call returns: profile/posts/full with limit=50 walks up to five pages server-side (at most 25 credits). Instagram Looter stopped at 12 posts per request.
